ISW via Kyiv Post — Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment July 20 2026. Key: Ukraine 400+ drone raid on Moscow region overnight (Sobyanin: 85 downed near capital), hit oil depot in Podolsk, Wildberries/Ozon logistics parks (Yuzhnye Vorota, Grivno), Zelensky confirmed also 6 Black Sea vessels (2 tankers + 4 dry cargo, incl shadow-fleet oil tankers) struck >400km from border. Russia's continued long-range strikes contributed to record-high civilian casualties in June 2026. Ukraine struck 103 pieces of energy infrastructure in occupied Crimea Jul 1-20. Russia launched 2 Kh-59/69 missiles + 94 drones overnight Jul 19-20; earlier (Jul 18-19) one of largest ballistic strikes on Kyiv Oblast (40 missiles), killing 1, injuring 16 — exploiting global Patriot interceptor shortage. Neither side made confirmed advances. (Ref: kyivindependent.com moscow-oblast-attack-july-20; understandingwar.org Jul 20 assessment.)
